name: Acrobatics
description: Balance, tumbles, escapes, and staying upright when the floor gets rude.

name: Animal Handling
description: Calming, guiding, reading, or working with animals.

name: Arcana
description: Knowledge of magic, magical traditions, spell effects, and arcane oddities.

name: Athletics
description: Climbing, jumping, swimming, grappling, shoving, and other physical force.

name: Deception
description: Lying, misdirection, disguising motives, and keeping a straight face under suspicion.

name: History
description: Recall of past events, old kingdoms, wars, legends, and notable people.

name: Insight
description: Reading motives, emotions, lies, and social tension.

name: Intimidation
description: Coercion through threat, presence, force of will, or terrifying posture.

name: Investigation
description: Searching, deduction, connecting clues, and solving practical mysteries.

name: Medicine
description: Stabilizing wounds, diagnosing illness, and understanding injuries.

name: Nature
description: Knowledge of terrain, plants, animals, weather, and natural hazards.

name: Perception
description: Spotting, hearing, smelling, and noticing what is easy to miss.

name: Performance
description: Entertaining, acting, music, dance, storytelling, and holding a crowd.

name: Persuasion
description: Honest influence, negotiation, diplomacy, and getting people to agree.

name: Religion
description: Knowledge of gods, rites, holy symbols, undead, cults, and sacred customs.

name: Sleight of Hand
description: Palming objects, subtle hand work, stage tricks, and quiet pocket business.

name: Stealth
description: Hiding, moving quietly, blending with shadows, and avoiding notice.

name: Survival
description: Tracking, foraging, navigation, reading weather, and staying alive outdoors.
